exact: degradation of host cell envelope lipopolysaccharide during viral entry
degradation of host lipopolysaccharide during virus entry
disruption by virus of host envelope lipopolysaccharide during virus entry
narrow: disassembly by virus of outer membrane lipopolysaccharide during viral entry

definition: The disruption by a symbiont of host cell wall lipopolysaccharides to allow entry into the host cell. For example a phage entering a Gram-negative bacterium may actively break down outer membrane lipopolysaccharides.
label: symbiont entry into host cell via disruption of host cell envelope lipopolysaccharide
